entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 2 (16 minions, 61/123)
entries.body:
Added: Mind Eater, Necrotic Mortician, Nerubian Flyer, Potionmaster
Putricide, Prismatic Elemental, Rotten Rodent, Silvermoon Farstrider,
Suspicious Peddler, Vrykul Necrolyte, Wretched Exile, Arcsplitter,
Asvedon the Grandshield, Blightfang, Brittleskin Zombie, Crystal Broker,
Darkfallen Shadow (+ Nerubian / Zombie / Concoction tokens).

Engine:
- per-spell bonusSpellDamage in the damage calc + grant-hand-school-
  spelldamage (Silvermoon Farstrider gives hand Arcane spells Spell Dmg+1).
- lastSpellPlayed tracked per player (any cost) + cast-enemy-last-spell
  (Asvedon).
- deckKeywordDiscount draw-time hook + reduce-deck-keyword-cost (Rotten
  Rodent: Deathrattle cards).
- copy-random-enemy-deck-card (Mind Eater); add-random-outcast-card on
  outcast-played (Wretched Exile); infect-enemies-summon-on-death +
  summon-for-player (Blightfang grants enemies a DR that summons YOU a
  Taunt Zombie).
- Reused: friendlyUndeadDied cond (Necrotic Mortician / Nerubian Flyer),
  grant-deathrattle (Vrykul), enemyTurn cond (Brittleskin), nested
  manathirst conditionals (Crystal Broker), grant-keyword-self reborn
  (Darkfallen Shadow), discover cost/costMod (Suspicious Peddler /
  Prismatic Elemental), add-card Arcane Bolts (Arcsplitter).

Simplifications: Concoctions unmodeled (Putricide adds a generic 2-cost
"deal 3" token; Ghoulish/Peddler guess minigames dropped); Necrotic
Mortician Unholy Rune -> Discover a Death Knight card.

entries.title: March of the Lich King batch 1 (16 minions, 45/123)
entries.body:
Set RETURN_OF_THE_LICH_KING start (Undead + Manathirst themes). Added:
Arcane Wyrm, Arms Dealer, Crystalsmith Cultist, Devourer of Souls, Fierce
Outsider, Scourge Tamer, Sunfury Champion, Trinket Tracker, Wailing
Banshee, Astalor Bloodsworn, Blood Matriarch Liadrin, Bone Flinger,
Coroner, Ghoulish Alchemist, Incorporeal Corporal, Magister's Apprentice
(+ Arcane Bolt / Astalor Protector+Flamewreath tokens).

Engine:
- Manathirst already modeled (conditional if:{manathirst:N} = mana.max>=N).
- buff-summoned-if-tribe extended: maxAttackSelf + grants[] (Liadrin DS+
  Rush on smaller summons); Arms Dealer reuses tribe+attack.
- gain-dead-deathrattle ongoing friendly-creature-died (Devourer of Souls).
- destroy-self self-attacks (Incorporeal Corporal); grant-next-outcast-
  discount + nextOutcastDiscount effectiveCost hook w/ same-play guard
  (Fierce Outsider); friendlyUndeadDied cond (Bone Flinger); buff-random-
  friendly gained tribe filter (Wailing Banshee).
- Reused: holdingSchool cond (Crystalsmith), spell-played+school Fire
  (Sunfury), schoolCostReduce Arcane static (Magister's Apprentice),
  freeze+conditional silence (Coroner), tutor cost 1 (Trinket Tracker),
  add-card (Arcane Wyrm / Astalor chain tokens).

Simplifications: Scourge Tamer Zombeast -> Discover a Beast; Ghoulish
Alchemist Concoction discount vanilla; Bone Flinger "after last turn" ->
any friendly Undead died this game; Astalor 3-stage chain via tokens.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batches 5-6 (20 minions, 109/109 COMPLETE)
entries.body:
Set BATTLE_OF_THE_BANDS done. Batch 5: Inzah, Kangor Dancing King, MC
Blingtron, Magatha Bane of Music, Opera Soloist, Rin Orchestrator of
Doom, Screaming Banshee, Summer Flowerchild, Doomkin, Lead Dancer, Mister
Mukla, Unpopular Has-Been, Zok Fogsnout, The One-Amalgam Band, Tony King
of Piracy, Concert Promo-Drake. Batch 6 (final): DJ Manastorm, Mish-Mash
Mosher, Banjosaur, Fanottem Lord of the Opera.

Engine:
- overloadDiscount + effectiveCost hook (Inzah); selfCost per:'deck-size'
  (Fanottem, base cost 0).
- heroHealed cond + summon-token-by-heal-amount ongoing 'healed'
  (Screaming Banshee).
- summon-hand-minion-lifesteal (Kangor); draw-give-spells-to-enemy
  (Magatha); both-players-draw-discard-mill (Rin); steal-empty-mana-
  crystal (Doomkin); replace-deck-with-enemy-copy (Tony); equip-both-mics
  (MC Blingtron, damage-amp omitted); gain-random-keywords-per-tribe-
  played (Amalgam Band); summon-quilboar-scaled (Zok, hero-Attack scaled);
  discount-hand-mincost (Summer Flowerchild Finale); buff-self-attack-
  random-enemy guarded chain (Mish-Mash); draw-beast-gain-stats
  (Banjosaur).

Reused: summon-from-deck-weaker (Lead Dancer), summon-random cost 5
(Unpopular Has-Been), give-enemy-card bananas (Mister Mukla), set-hand-
spell-cost (DJ Manastorm), conditional noOtherCreatures / Finale destroy
(Opera Soloist / Concert Promo-Drake). Simplifications: DJ Manastorm's
post-cast escalation, MC Blingtron's damage-amp, Zok's armor-this-turn,
Amalgam Band's exact Bonus-Effect pool all approximated.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 4 (16 minions, 89/109)
entries.body:
Added: Freebird, Grimtotem Buzzkill, Halveria Darkraven, Instrument
Smasher, Jitterbug, Keyboard Soloist, Obsessive Fan, Pozzik Audio
Engineer, Rhythmdancer Risa, Speaker Stomper, Yelling Yodeler,
Boneshredder, Drum Soloist, Elite Tauren Champion, Ghost Writer, Guitar
Soloist (+ Amp / Bot tokens).

Engine:
- playedCountById tracked at play resolve -> Freebird buff-self-per-
  played-id.
- FIX: aura-granted Stealth now clears `stealthed` when the aura lapses
  (Obsessive Fan grant-stealth-while-alive via aura.targetUid; same fix
  benefits any aura-stealth source).
- discard-weapon-draw (Grimtotem); bounce-self-set-cost (Rhythmdancer
  Risa hero-attacks ongoing); corpse-gain-deathrattle (Boneshredder);
  trigger-one-deathrattle gained count (Yelling Yodeler x2).
- Reused: friendly-attacks + keyword rush cond -> buff friendlies
  (Halveria); weapon-destroyed -> equip (Instrument Smasher); friendly-
  divine-shield-lost -> draw (Jitterbug); tax-enemy-spells (Speaker
  Stomper); add-card toEnemy + deathrattle summon (Pozzik); spell-damage
  static token (Keyboard Soloist Amps); conditional noOtherCreatures
  (Drum/Guitar Soloist); Finale discover (Ghost Writer).

Simplification: Elite Tauren Champion's ROCK DUEL (spend-all-mana-or-take-8
global) left as vanilla Finale flavor; Boneshredder ties to real Corpse
resource.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 3 (16 minions, 73/109)
entries.body:
Added: Outfit Tailor, Paparazzi, Photographer Fizzle, Plagiarizarrr,
Power Slider, Rhyme Spinner, Rock Master Voone, Rowdy Fan, Tough Crowd,
Worgen Roadie, Ambient Lightspawn, Backstage Bouncer, Candleraiser,
Cover Artist, Crazed Conductor, E.T.C. Band Manager (+ Instrument Case
token).

Engine:
- tribesPlayedGame set + combosPlayedGame counter tracked at play resolve
  -> Power Slider / Rhyme Spinner buff-self-per-tribe/combo-played.
- Rowdy Fan: aura.targetUid filter in recomputeAuras (buff a specific
  minion while source lives; removed automatically on death).
- buff-target-by-source-stats (Outfit Tailor); copy-enemy-deck-top
  (Plagiarizarrr); snapshot-hand-into-deck (Photographer Fizzle);
  copy-hand-minions-distinct-tribe (Rock Master Voone); grant-adjacent-
  keyword (Candleraiser Finale DS); become-copy-of-random-minion 3/3
  (Cover Artist); fatigue-summon (Crazed Conductor).
- Ambient Lightspawn: Finale + Overheal both buff-random-friendly.

Reused: transform-target-into-source (Backstage Bouncer), Outcast bounce
(Tough Crowd), summon forEnemy (Worgen Roadie), discover rarity legendary
(Paparazzi). Simplifications: Photographer Fizzle once-per-game not
enforced; E.T.C. deckbuild band -> plain Discover a minion; Rock Master
Voone one copy per distinct tribe.

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 2 (16 minions, 57/109)
entries.body:
Added: Dreamboat, Fanboy, Groovy Cat, Hipster, Jukebox Totem, One Hit
Wonder, Party Animal, Popular Pixie, Rolling Stone, Snakebite, Cowbell
Soloist, Festival Security, Harmonica Soloist, Heartthrob, Holotechnician,
Metrognome.

Engine:
- Overheal already modeled (card `overheal` field runs on heal overflow) ->
  Heartthrob summon-random-cost-overheal (source._lastOverheal); Dreamboat
  heal-friendlies-buff-per-overheal.
- creature-damaged ctx now carries `amount` + damageAmount cond ->
  Holotechnician destroy-damaged-subject on exactly-1 damage.
- lastCardCost tracking (playCard + spell resolve) + conditional cond ->
  Rolling Stone; buff target:'self' case added.
- buff-self-per-died-this-turn (Snakebite); force-all-enemies-attack
  (Festival Security Finale); discover-enemy-class-spell (Hipster);
  metrognome escalating draw (card-played ongoing, per-source metroCost);
  grant-keyword-self poisonous Combo (One Hit Wonder).

Reused: refresh-hero-power / hero-power-discount Choose One (Popular
Pixie), buff+grant Choose One (Fanboy), hero-temp-attack (Groovy Cat),
turn-end summon recruit (Jukebox Totem), conditional noOtherCreatures +
damage / discover installSecret (Cowbell / Harmonica Soloist), buff-hand-
minions (Party Animal). Simplifications: Groovy Cat/Free-Spirit-style
Hero-Power-per-game upgrades approximated as one-time; Party Animal buffs
all hand minions (not one-per-tribe).

entries.title: Festival of Legends batch 1 (16 minions, 41/109)
entries.body:
Set BATTLE_OF_THE_BANDS start. Added: Air Guitarist, Annoying Fan,
Costumed Singer, Crowd Surfer, Flowrider, Free Spirit, Peaceful Piper,
Razorfen Rockstar, Saxophone Soloist, Thornmantle Musician, Arrow Smith,
Audio Amplifier, Audio Medic, Audio Splitter, Baritone Imp, Disc Jockey.

Engine:
- Finale already modeled (conditional if:{finale} = availableMana 0 after
  play) -> Audio Medic, Thornmantle.
- lock-minion-attack + cantAttackWhile check in canAttackWith (Annoying
  Fan); damage-lowest-enemy (Arrow Smith spell-played ongoing).
- set-own-max-mana (Audio Amplifier); copy-highest-spell (Audio Splitter);
  fatigue-self-buff (Baritone Imp); add-random-combo-card (Disc Jockey).
- gain-armor-no-trigger + Razorfen Rockstar armor-gained ongoing (avoids
  self-loop); buff-next-summon-tribe + summon() hook (Thornmantle);
  grant-keyword-self (Audio Medic Finale); buff-random-other-grant-
  deathrattle (Crowd Surfer chaining DR).

Reused buff-weapon (Air Guitarist), tutor secret turn-end (Costumed
Singer), conditional overloaded->discover fromOwnDeck (Flowrider),
noOtherCreatures->add-card (Saxophone Soloist), Choose One tutor/discover
Beast (Peaceful Piper). Simplification: Free Spirit gains 1 Armor now
(Hero-Power-armor-per-game unmodeled); Audio Amplifier hand-size cap
approximated by MAX_HAND.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 5 (final 14 legendaries, 100/100)
entries.body:
Set COMPLETE. Added: Theotar the Mad Duke, Huntsman Altimor, Remornia
Living Blade, Sinfueled Golem, The Countess, Topior the Shrubbagazzor,
Artificer Xy'mox, Kel'Thuzad the Inevitable, Party Crasher, Sesselie of
the Fae Court, Torghast Custodian, Insatiable Devourer, Sire Denathrius,
The Jailer (+ Gargon / Whelp / Invitation / infused tokens).

Engine:
- devour-enemy (Insatiable Devourer) + Infuse neighbors variant.
- destroy-own-deck-gain-immune (The Jailer).
- gain-random-keyword-per-enemy-minion (Torghast Custodian).
- throw-hand-minion (Party Crasher); swap-random-hand-cards (Theotar);
  equip-self-as-weapon self-attacks ongoing (Remornia).
- add-card requireDeckNoNeutral gate (The Countess -> Legendary
  Invitations); discover rarity filter (also fixes Suspicious Usher).
- Topior emblem: spell-played + school Nature -> summon 3/3 Rush Whelp.
- Reused: random-damage pool enemies + lifesteal (Sire Denathrius; Infuse
  deals 6), summon-died-name (Kel'Thuzad Skeletons), tutor costMod -8
  deathrattle (Sesselie), summon Gargon Infuse (Altimor).

Simplifications (flagged): Artificer Xy'mox vanilla (Relics unmodeled),
Sinfueled Golem Infuse -> fixed 8/8 (infuser-stat sum approximated),
Theotar/Party Crasher approximate the Discover/throw picks, Remornia
re-equips each swing, Sire Denathrius Infuse single-step (not endless),
Altimor two-tier Infuse collapsed to one, Kel'Thuzad Skeletons by name.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 4 (16 minions, 86/100)
entries.body:
Added: Widowbloom Seedsman, Ara'lon, Death Blossom Whomper, Elitist Snob,
Famished Fool, Lady Darkvein, Mawsworn Bailiff, Necrolord Draka,
Shadehound, Soul Seeker, Steamcleaner, Stoneborn Accuser, Decimator
Olgra, Defense Attorney Nathanos, Imp King Rafaam, Sylvanas the Accused
(+ Shade / infused tokens). Also fixes Framester art (MAW_005; had been
fetched as Soul Seeker's MAW_004).

Engine:
- gain-empty-mana-crystal (Widowbloom, via tutor school Nature).
- Death Blossom Whomper reuses tutor requireKeyword+gainDeathrattle.
- gain-random-keyword-per-class-card (Elitist Snob).
- buff-self-if-armor (Mawsworn Bailiff); equip-per-cards-played
  (Necrolord Draka); buff-friendly-tribe self-attacks ongoing
  (Shadehound) + Infuse Rush variant.
- buff-self-per-damaged-then-attack-all (Decimator Olgra).
- summon-died-name (Imp King Rafaam: resurrect Imps) + buff-friendly-name
  Infuse variant; swap-with-enemy-deck-minion (Soul Seeker).
- Sylvanas: destroy -> mind-control Infuse; Stoneborn Accuser / Famished
  Fool Infuse variants (deal 5 / draw 3).

Simplifications (flagged): Steamcleaner vanilla (deck-origin untracked),
Ara'lon summons 3 identical Wildseeds (one Wildseed type modeled), Lady
Darkvein Shades lack the cast-last-Shadow-spell Deathrattle, Defense
Attorney Nathanos gains a died minion's Deathrattle but does not auto-
trigger it, Shadehound Infuse counts any friendly death (not Beasts only).

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 3 (16 minions, 70/100)
entries.body:
Added: Baroness Vashj, Buffet Biggun, Chatty Bartender, Dispossessed
Soul, Halkias, Incriminating Psychic, Mischievous Imp, Murlocula, Orion
Mansion Manager, Partner in Crime, Private Eye, Prosecutor Mel'tranix,
Scuttlebutt Ghoul, Sightless Magistrate, Stonebound Gargon, The
Stonewright (+ infused / buffed-recruit tokens).

Engine:
- summon-copy-of-self (Mischievous Imp, Scuttlebutt Ghoul w/ requireSecret)
  + Infuse variants that summon two.
- grant-self-endturn-summon-copy (Partner in Crime): a one-shot turn-end
  ongoing that summons a copy.
- cast-secret-from-deck (Private Eye; Combo casts 2 via combo field).
- copy-random-enemy-hand (Incriminating Psychic deathrattle).
- draw-both-until (Sightless Magistrate).
- Buffet Biggun Infuse: infused token summons Divine-Shield +2-Attack
  Silver Hand Recruits; The Stonewright reuses the emblem aura
  (tribe Totem +2 Attack); Chatty Bartender reuses controlSecret turn-end
  damage; Murlocula Infuse -> 0-cost lifesteal token.

Simplifications (flagged): Baroness Vashj (transform-redirect), Orion
(secret-revealed trigger), Prosecutor Mel'tranix (hand-lock), Dispossessed
Soul (Locations), Halkias (soul-in-Secret -> Deathrattle returns to hand),
Stonebound Gargon Infuse cleave unmodeled (plain Rush).

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 2 (16 minions, 54/100)
entries.body:
Added: Creepy Painting, Demolition Renovator, Dinner Performer, Forensic
Duster, Framester, Ghastly Gravedigger, Invitation Courier, Muckborn
Servant, Murloc Holmes, Party Favor Totem, Pelagos, Shadowborn, Stewart
the Steward, Suspicious Pirate, The Harvester of Envy, Weapons Expert
(+ Framed / infused Party Favor tokens).

Engine:
- become-copy-of-dead ongoing (creature-died) — Creepy Painting.
- summon-from-deck-affordable (Dinner Performer); enemy-minion-tax-next-
  turn + effectiveCost hook (Forensic Duster); shuffle-cards-into-enemy-
  deck (Framester); shuffle-enemy-hand-card-choose w/ requireSecret
  (Ghastly Gravedigger); reduce-highest-school-spell (Shadowborn);
  summon-random-basic-totem + Infuse variant (Party Favor Totem).
- grant-next-recruit-buff + summon() Silver Hand Recruit hook, with
  self-chaining Deathrattle (Stewart the Steward).
- buff-weapon-or-draw-weapon (Weapons Expert).

Reused discover (cardClasses paladin / cardType weapon / fromEnemyHand)
for Muckborn Servant, Suspicious Pirate, Murloc Holmes. Simplifications:
Demolition Renovator vanilla (locations/Tradeable unmodeled), Invitation
Courier + The Harvester of Envy + Pelagos vanilla (copied-card/spell-
target triggers unmodeled), Framed overload-on-draw not modeled,
Suspicious/Murloc guess minigames dropped.

entries.title: Murder at Castle Nathria batch 1 (16 minions, 38/100)
entries.body:
Infuse set. Added: Dredger Staff, Sinful Sous Chef, Sinstone Totem,
Suspicious Alchemist, Suspicious Usher, Anonymous Informant, Attorney-at-
Maw, Bibliomite, Class Action Lawyer, Crooked Cook, Imp-oster, Mysterious
Visitor, Priest of the Deceased, Sketchy Stranger, Spirit Poacher, Ashen
Elemental (+ Silver Hand/Wildseed/infused tokens).

Engine:
- Infuse system: infuse {count,id} field + infuseCounter; a hand card
  transforms into its infused form after N friendly minions die (Priest
  of the Deceased).
- damageToEnemyHeroThisTurn tracking + dealtHeroDamage cond (Crooked Cook).
- enemyDrawPunish (drawPunishTurn/Damage) + drawCards hook (Ashen
  Elemental); shuffle-hand-card-into-deck (Bibliomite); set-target-stats
  + requireDeckNoNeutral guard (Class Action Lawyer); become-copy-of-
  target fullCopy variant (Imp-oster; Nameless One kept via silence flag).

Reused buff-hand-minions (Dredger Staff), next-secret-cost (Anonymous
Informant), grant-immune-turn/silence Choose One (Attorney-at-Maw),
Dormant+awaken (Wildseed). Simplifications: Suspicious cards drop the
guess minigame, Mysterious Visitor vanilla, Sketchy Stranger any-class
secret.

entries.title: Finish Voyage to the Sunken City (115/115 minions)
entries.body:
Final 23: Twinbow Terrorcoil, Azsharan Sentinel, Bootstrap Sunkeneer,
Commander Ulthok, Ini Stormcoil, Lady Ashvane, Lady Naz'jar, Queen
Azshara, Za'qul, Barbaric Sorceress, Coilskar Commander, Green-Thumb
Gardener, Stormcoil Mothership, Blackscale Brute, Hedra the Heretic,
Pirate Admiral Hooktusk, Slithering Deathscale, The Leviathan, Wrathspine
Enchanter, Gigafin, Tidal Revenant, Trenchstalker, Neptulon (+ tokens).

Engine:
- bounce-to-deck-bottom (Bootstrap Sunkeneer combo); summon-copy-of-
  target-buffed (Ini Stormcoil); refresh-highest-spell (Green-Thumb
  Gardener); hedra (summon per held spell's cost, uses spellsHeldIds);

  (Lady Ashvane); destroy-all-enemies (Gigafin).
- attack-random-enemy gained count (Trenchstalker: 3 different enemies).

Reused set-next-spell-double (Twinbow), spellsCastWhileHeld conds
(Coilskar/Slithering/Queen), summon-copy-self count (Coilskar), summon-
random tribe/maxCost (Stormcoil Mothership), weaponEquipped (Blackscale),
self-attacks dredge (The Leviathan), put-on-bottom (Azsharan Sentinel),
Abyssal Curse (Za'qul). Simplifications: Colossal dropped (Leviathan/
Gigafin/Neptulon main bodies only), Health-cost (Ulthok) / relic (Queen
Azshara) / plunder (Hooktusk) / Lady Naz'jar transform approximated.

Sunken City collectible minions now 100%. Card total 4,185.
26 Hearthstone sets complete.

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 4 (16 minions, 92/115)
entries.body:

Saber, Baba Naga, Blademaster Okani, Bubblebot, Coilfang Constrictor,
Commander Sivara, Disarming Elemental, Excavation Specialist, Igneous

  add-back-held-spells (Commander Sivara).
- lock-enemy-hand-card + lockedUntilTurn guard in canPlay (Coilfang
  Constrictor: a card can't be played next turn).

Azsharan deathrattles), spellsCastWhileHeld cond (Baba Naga), grant
friendly-others ifTribe (Bubblebot Mechs), creature-played tribe-gated
refresh-mana (Spitelash Siren), set-next-spell-discount 99 (Swiftscale),
add-card + discover (School Teacher), four more Dredge minions (riders
simplified). Simplification: Blademaster Okani vanilla (counter dropped),
Disarming Elemental self-dredge, Colossal = plain 8/8 token.

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 3 (16 minions, 76/115)
entries.body:
Added: Crushclaw Enforcer, Cutlass Courier, Handmaiden, Herald of Chaos/
Light/Nature/Shadows, Lady S'theno, Mecha-Shark, Myrmidon, Piranha
Poacher, Radiance of Azshara, Shimmering Sunfish, Sira'kess Cultist,
Smothering Starfish, Snapdragon (+ Abyssal Curse token).

Engine:
- Naga school tracking: schoolsWhileHeld set on hand cards when a spell of
  that school is cast + schoolWhileHeld cond (the four Heralds).
- attack-lowest-enemy (Lady S'theno on spell-played); steal-health
  (Herald of Shadows); silence-all exceptSource (Smothering Starfish);
  buff-hand-tribe-keyword (Snapdragon Battlecry minions).
- Abyssal Curse = drawTrigger token dealing 3 to its holder (Sira'kess).

Reused spellsCastWhileHeld cond (Crushclaw/Handmaiden), hero-attacks tutor
(Cutlass Courier Pirate), summoned tribe-gated random-damage (Mecha-Shark),
spell-cast-on-creature selfTarget draw (Myrmidon), schoolCostReduce +
school-gated armor (Radiance), holdingSchool (Shimmering Sunfish), heal
friendly-all (Herald of Light). Simplification: Radiance drops Fire Spell
Damage +2; Snapdragon buffs hand (deck approximated).

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 2 (16 minions, 60/115)
entries.body:
Added: Murkwater Scribe, Obsidiansmith, Queensguard, Raj Naz'jan, Seafloor
Savior, Security Automaton, Spellcoiler, Spirit of the Tides, Submerged
Spacerock, Voidgill, Wayward Sage, Ancient Krakenbane, Azsharan
Mooncatcher, Azsharan Sweeper, Bloodscent Vilefin, Clownfish (+ Sunken
Mooncatcher/Sweeper tokens).

- Naga "cast a spell while holding this": spellsCastWhileHeld counter on
  every hand card when a spell is played + cond (Spellcoiler >=1, Ancient
  Krakenbane >=3).
- nextSpellDiscount (Murkwater Scribe) and nextTribeDiscount {tribe,count,

- buff-self per:'spells-this-turn' (Queensguard); damage-hero-by-spell-
  cost switch case (Raj Naz'jan); buff-self-if-unspent-mana (Spirit of
  the Tides); buff-hand-tribe (Voidgill); reduce-hand-edges-cost (Wayward
  Sage Outcast).

Reused Dredge (Obsidiansmith/Seafloor/Bloodscent, riders simplified),
put-on-bottom (Azsharan Mooncatcher/Sweeper), summoned tribe-gated buff-
self (Security Automaton), conjure-random mage spells (Submerged Spacerock,
Temporary dropped).

entries.title: Voyage to the Sunken City batch 1 (16 minions, 44/115)

entries.title: Battlecards duel: fix stale creature faces on the guest (1/3 vs 6/2 desync)
entries.body:
Report: a Mana Wyrm read 1/3 on one player's screen and 6/2 on the other's.

Root cause was rendering, not game state. The guest never runs the event
animator: it ingests the host's authoritative snapshots (events discarded)
and drives the board purely through layoutTargets -> entityFor. entityFor
rebinds ent.card to the fresh snapshot object but never repainted the cached
face texture, so a creature's 3D face froze at its summon-time stats while
the underlying state (and the host, which is event-driven) moved on. A Mana
Wyrm that grew via spell casts kept showing 1/3 on the guest.

Fix: give each entity a faceSig() of everything the face renders (stats,
keywords, shield/stealth/disguise, cost, durability, loyalty, progress) and
repaint whenever it changes. entityFor now refreshes the face on any stat
drift — the guest's only sync path — and refreshFace keeps the signature in
step so the event-driven path doesn't double-paint. General safety net for
solo/host too.

entries.title: press-and-hold to preview the hero power without using it
entries.body:
Same treatment as cards. The class-power orb previously fired on press, so
trying to read it triggered it.

- Pressing the orb now arms it instead of activating; a quick release uses
  the power, a press-and-hold (~380ms) opens its full reader instead.
- The long-press preview resolves the hero power via classPowerOf (the orb
  has no card uid of its own) and shows it in the card reader.
- The reader gains a "Use <power>" button so it can also be triggered
  deliberately from the preview, mirroring a hand card's Play button.
- clearModes() resets the armed orb.

entries.title: press-and-hold to preview a card without casting it
entries.body:
Playtest pain: cards cast on release when the player only meant to look at
them (any pointer move >=14px on release counted as a drag-to-play), and the
hold-to-preview gesture was wired for touch only.

- Arm the long-press on every card press (desktop + touch), not just touch.
- A ~380ms hold now opens the full card reader (showInspect) — which already
  carries an explicit "Play" button — instead of the small hover tooltip.
- Once a hold fires, the release is a no-op: the drag-to-play branch is gated
  on !longPressFired, so a previewed card can never cast on release. The play
  hint and green placement marker are likewise suppressed during a preview.
- Quick drag-to-play is unchanged: moving >12px before the hold timer cancels
  it, so deliberate drags still play normally.

entries.body:

- New #mana-hud chip pinned bottom-left, always in the clear; mirrors

entries.title: Fix ongoing-based colour boosts (Bolster, Inspire, etc.) being dropped
entries.body:
applyRollEntry attached a boost's `ongoing` only when the creature had no
ongoing of its own (`if (entry.ongoing && !t.ongoing)`) -- so boosting a
creature that already had any ability silently discarded the boost. That
made "Frenzy: Bolster 1", "Inspire: Gain +1/+1", "Inspire: Bolster 1",
Prowess, Avenge, and "Connect: Adapt" appear to do nothing on most
creatures.

Now the first trigger fills the singular slot and any further boosts stack
into the `ongoings` array (which fireOngoing already iterates). The inline
self-damaged handler in damageCreature only checked the singular slot, so
it now scans `ongoings` too, tracking one-shot Frenzy via a `spent` flag.

Verified: Bolster and Inspire now fire when stacked onto a creature that
already has an ongoing, and one-shot Frenzy still fires exactly once.

entries.title: Make Adapt's Poisonous the real poisonous keyword (not deathtouch)
entries.body:

(damage applies Poisoned; Poisoned creatures lose 2 Health at the end of
their controller's turn -- exactly the paper rule), but the Adapt d10
table mapped "Poisonous" to deathtouch as an approximation. Point it at
the real 'poisonous' keyword so Adapt #10 poisons instead of destroying
outright.

Also fixes the B boost-table "Venomous" entry, which was likewise mapped
to deathtouch, to the real 'venomous' keyword. Tightened the Poisonous
glossary text to state the 2-Health end-of-turn tick.

Verified in combat: a poisonous attacker leaves a big creature alive but
Poisoned (loses 2 at end of its controller's turn), while deathtouch
destroys immediately with no Poisoned status.

three rolled upgrades -- instead of the old auto-apply single roll and
instead of Hearthstone's fixed choose-one-of-three.

Engine:
- queueAdapt(): rolls 3 distinct options, pushes an { mode:'adapt' } entry
  onto pickQueue, emits 'adaptOffer'
- adapt effect now supports tribe targeting ("Adapt your Murlocs" -> one
  choice applied to every matching creature) and times:N ("Adapt twice")
- resolvePick() handles mode:'adapt' -- applies the chosen ADAPT_TABLE
  entry to every still-living target
- reuses pickQueue so MP sync + AI resolution already carry it

Client (game.js): openPickModal renders the 3 labelled options; 'adaptOffer'
opens it for the human; AI (game.js + ai.js) scores options and takes the
strongest. index.html gets an .adapt-opt style. keywords.js glossary updated
to the paper rule.

Adds 5 Adapt cards to exercise it: Crackling Razormaw, Ravasaur Runt,
Vicious Fledgling, Gentle Megasaur, Ravenous Pterrordax. Feature verified
in a 14-check engine test (offers, targeting, multi-target same-adaptation,

1-mana 1/2 Human Soldier whose battlecry uses the new Investigate keyword
to make a Clue token. Verified in-node.

entries.title: register Investigate / Enrich / Cook as keywords
entries.body:
Glossary entries (with card-text bolding + tooltips) for the three
token-making effect-words, backed by the existing investigate/enrich/cook
effects: Investigate -> Clue (sac, pay 2: draw), Enrich -> Treasure (sac:
gain 1 mana), Cook -> Food (sac, pay 2: heal 3).

entries.title: Martyred Rusalka wording -> Freeze
entries.body:
The ability already used the freeze effect; reworded the text/description
from "Tap a creature" to "Freeze a creature" to match the game's term.

entries.title: retribe Cats, Dogs, and Pegasi as Beasts
entries.body:
9 cards updated: Cat/Dog/Pegasus -> Beast in tribe strings, deduping
compound types (Cat Beast -> Beast, Cat Cleric -> Beast Cleric, Cat Soldier
-> Beast Soldier, Undead Cat -> Undead Beast).

entries.title: true 70 per color in the gallery count (13 non-land cards)
entries.body:
The /designwiki gallery buckets each card under the first WUBRG colour it
has and excludes lands/tokens — so the earlier "70" (which counted colored
basic lands) overshot the lands but left the real card pool at 67-69. Added
13 vanilla non-land creatures so every colour's gallery bucket is exactly
70: W +2, U +3, B +2, R +3, G +3 (R needed extra since multicolour cards
bucket under their earlier colour). Verified against the wiki's exact
systemBucket logic.

entries.title: strip Menace & Reach flavor keywords too
entries.body:
Completes removal of the inert combat keywords (no blocking in this format):
Menace and Reach stripped from all cards/tokens, descriptions cleaned, and
their glossary entries removed. No flavor-only evasion keywords remain.

entries.title: remove Flying & Vigilance flavor keywords; Lifelink -> Lifesteal
entries.body:
Per design, no inert flavor keywords: stripped Flying (34 cards) and
Vigilance (12 cards) from every card and token, cleaned their descriptions,
and removed both glossary entries. Cards that were only Flying/Vigilance
are now vanilla. Also renamed every "Lifelink" mention to "Lifesteal" in
card text (the engine keyword was already 'lifesteal'). Menace and Reach
remain for now.

entries.title: Spectral Procession spirits gain Lifesteal
entries.body:
The 1/1 Spirits now have Lifesteal (kept Flying as flavor). They were
already creature tokens (the summon effect sets token:true, so they exile
on death and can't be bounced to hand). Verified in-node.

entries.title: fill all five colors to exactly 70 (65 vanilla/keyword creatures)
entries.body:
Simple non-legendary bodies from Scryfall closing the remaining gaps:
White +7, Blue +7, Black +18, Red +13, Green +20. Evasion keywords
(Flying/Vigilance/Menace/Reach) are flavor with no rules effect; hexproof
maps to Elusive, haste to Charge, lifelink to Lifesteal. Every WUBRG color
now sits at 70 collectible cards.

entries.title: 28 vanilla/keyword-only creatures (Green + Blue fill)
entries.body:
Simple non-legendary bodies from Scryfall to grow the two biggest gaps.
Green (15): Argothian Swine, Assault Zeppelid, Beast in Show, Ambush Viper
(deathtouch), Archers of Qarsi, Bassara Tower Archer (hexproof->elusive),
Alpine Grizzly, Axebane Beast, Centaur Courser, Craw Wurm, Elvish Warrior,
Durkwood Boars, Feral Krushok, Colossodon Yearling, Cylian Elf.
Blue (13): Air Elemental, Azure Drake, Cloud Manta, Fighting Drake, Bay
Falcon, Faerie Invaders, Giant Octopus, Coral Commando, Amphin Cutthroat,
Horned Turtle, Tolarian Scholar, Ancient Crab, Maritime Guard.
Evasion keywords are flavor (no rules effect). Green 39->54, Blue 50->63.

entries.title: 12 simple activated-ability creatures (Scryfall-sourced)
entries.body:
Non-legendary sac-outlets, firebreathing-style pumps, and pay-life pumps —
all mana / sacrifice / life costs, none tap. Black: Viscera Seer, Carrion
Feeder, Bloodthrone Vampire, Plagued Rusalka, Cutthroat Contender, Grimclaw
Bats. Red: Scorched Rusalka, Blazing Rootwalla, Bold Impaler, Bellows
Lizard. Green: Starved Rusalka. White: Martyred Rusalka. Verified in-node:
sac-to-scry, mana+sac burn, once-per-turn vs repeatable pumps, pay-life
pumps, and mana+life combined costs. B 47->53, R 53->57, G 38->39, W 62->63.

entries.title: drop tap from activated abilities (creatures don't tap)
entries.body:
Per design: creatures never tap in this format, so activated abilities may
cost mana, life, or a sacrifice — but not tapping. Reverted the tap cost
(summoning-sickness gate + can't-attack-after) and removed the three
tap-for-mana dorks (Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Fyndhorn Elves) that
relied on it. Kept the sacrifice-a-creature cost (Goblin Sledder, Goblin
Trashmaster) and mana-cost abilities (Elvish Herder, {G} written as a
neutral 1). Colored ability costs are authored as generic mana.

Verified in-node: Elvish Herder's 1-mana grant works without tapping,
Goblin Sledder's sac-a-Goblin buff still resolves. Green 41->38, Red 53.

entries.title: activated-ability costs (tap + sacrifice-a-creature) + 6 cards
entries.body:
Extends the existing activated-ability system (which already had mana /
sacrifice-self / pay-life / discard costs and full client UI):
- `tap: true` abilities respect summoning sickness (can't use the turn it
  enters) and tapping means the creature can't attack that turn -> real
  mana dorks.
- `sacCost: { tribe? }` costs sacrifice another creature (auto if only one
  legal, else the sacQueue picker prompts), then the ability resolves.

Cards: Llanowar Elves / Elvish Mystic / Fyndhorn Elves / Elvish Herder (G),
Goblin Sledder / Goblin Trashmaster (R). Verified in-node: dork sickness/
once-per-turn/can't-attack-after, sac-a-Goblin auto & prompted, buff target,
Goblin lord aura + sac-to-destroy. No client changes (ability menu + sac
picker already wired). Green 37->41, Red 51->53.

entries.title: Green roster wave toward 70 (3 cards)
entries.body:
Chardalyn Dragon (flyer), Questing Beast (haste/deathtouch, plus inert
vigilance & can't-be-blocked-by-small as flavor), Reito Sentinel (defender;
mill the enemy 3). Green 34 -> 37. Green's remaining pool is mostly
tap/mana-ability ramp, Elves, and big creatures with complex triggers.

entries.title: Black roster wave toward 70 (4 cards) + X fixes
entries.body:
Vampire Interloper (flyer), Exsanguinate (X drain), Mind Shatter (X random
discard), Bitterblossom (turn-start: lose 1, make a Faerie). heal and
enemy-discard now resolve value/count 'X' from the caster's xValue (they
didn't before). Verified in-node. Black 43 -> 47.

entries.title: Red roster wave toward 70 (4 cards)
entries.body:
Ball Lightning & Spark Elemental (haste/trample, self-destruct at end of
turn via a turn-end damage-self ongoing), Gamble (search any + random
discard), Pulverize (alt-cost sac 2 Mountains -> destroy all artifacts).
Verified in-node. Red 47 -> 51. Red's faithful pool is thin (most remaining
are Goblins with activated/tribal abilities or Dragons with complex
triggers), so it lands short of 70 per the faithful-only choice.

entries.title: Blue roster wave toward 70 (10 cards)
entries.body:
Wind Drake / Storm Crow / Faerie Miscreant (flyers), Mulldrifter (draw 2),
Boomerang (bounce a permanent), Into the Roil (bounce + kicker draw),
Trinket Mage (tutor a small artifact), Sower of Temptation (steal a
creature), Swan Song (counter noncreature -> opponent gets a 2/2 Bird),
Sage Owl (Scry 3). Verified in-node. Blue 40 -> 50.

entries.title: White roster wave toward 70 (10 cards) + evasion-as-flavor
entries.body:
Toward the 70-per-color goal. Evasion keywords (Flying/Vigilance/Menace/
Reach) are mechanically inert in a no-block format, so they're now imported
as flavor with glossary notes stating they have no rules effect here — the
honest way to include those cards.

White: Doomed Traveler, Kor Hookmaster (freeze), Spectral Procession &
Midnight Haunting (Spirit tokens), Cathars' Crusade (buff on each ETB),
Ajani's Pridemate (grows on lifegain), Kor Scythemaster, Serra Avenger,
Idyllic Tutor (search enchantment), Kor Skyfisher (bounce a permanent).
All use existing/built mechanics; verified in-node. White 52 -> 62.

entries.title: proliferate (adapted to this game's buff model) + Flux Channeler
entries.body:
This game had no live counter usage (0 cards used the counters field; all 45
permanent buffs go through buffCreature). Per design call, any permanent
+1/+1 now banks a "counter": buffCreature increments c.counters by
min(atk,hp) on a positive +N/+N. Proliferate then grows each of your
strengthened creatures (counters > 0) by +1/+1 and each of your
planeswalkers by 1 loyalty. add-counters no longer double-increments (the
buff primitive owns it now). Kept the keyword name "Proliferate" but the
reminder text avoids the word "counter" (which here means counterspell).

Card: Flux Channeler (whenever you cast a noncreature spell, Proliferate).
Verified in-node: buff-self banks counters, plain creatures don't;
proliferate grows strengthened creatures only, and planeswalker loyalty.

Skipped: Cankerbloom (activated sac + choose-one) and Unnatural Restoration
(return-a-permanent-from-graveyard + proliferate) need more mechanics.

entries.title: bounce any permanent + a 'permanent' target kind
entries.body:
"Return target permanent" now hits creatures, artifacts, enchantments,
planeswalkers, and locations (Cryptic Command's bounce mode). Engine:
legalTargets gains a 'permanent' kind that offers every permanent across
zones; findPermanent + bouncePermanent locate a target in any zone and
return it to its owner's hand (tokens still cease to exist; equipment
detaches; auras recompute). CHOSEN/targetSpec learn 'permanent'.

Client: play-targeting now matches any legal permanent by uid (tap ×2,
drag resolveDropTarget, and the target-ring highlight) — attack targeting
is unchanged (still creatures/walkers only). Artifacts/enchantments/
planeswalkers were already clickable entities, so no new rendering.

Verified in-node: legalTargets permanent lists creature/artifact/
enchantment; bouncing each returns the card to hand; Cryptic [bounce,draw]
targets and bounces an artifact. Creature-only spells are unaffected.
The expanded targeting UI needs a live realm test.

entries.title: Cryptic Command (modal choose-two with mixed targeting)
entries.body:
Ties together the recent mechanics: choose-two (array choice), the two-step
targeting, and the counter stack. New counter-stack effect counters the
topmost spell at resolution (Cryptic's counter mode, cast in response).
Bounce reuses creature bounce, tap-all reuses mass freeze, draw is draw.

Client: the multi-choice menu now takes a commit callback and routes to
targeting when a chosen mode needs one (Cryptic's bounce), via
continueModalPlay; the respond window gains modal support so a modal
instant (Cryptic) can be cast in response — continueModalRespond picks
modes, targets if needed, then submits. Choice arrays already thread
through play + respond.

Verified in-node: counter+draw in response (spell countered, card drawn),
bounce+tap (one enemy bounced, the rest frozen), bounce+draw, and array-
choice targetSpec (bounce needs a creature, tap/draw need none).

Notes: "return target permanent" is creature-only here (no artifact/
enchantment/land bounce); the AI casts Cryptic sub-optimally (skips it in
response, fizzles a mode-less cast on its turn). Modal menu + respond
targeting need a live realm test.

entries.title: cost-reduction / affinity + Ghalta, Thalia, Goblin Warchief
entries.body:
Two small additions to the existing cost engine: selfCost gains a
'board-power' mode (a card's own cost drops by the total power of your
creatures — Ghalta), and costTypeMatches gains 'noncreature' (Thalia's
tax). Board cost auras (costMod) and tribe keyword-granting auras were
already supported. All engine-side (the client already displays
effectiveCost), so no client changes.

Cards: Ghalta, Primal Hunger (costs 1 less per point of board power;
Trample), Thalia, Guardian of Thraben (First strike; noncreature spells
cost 1 more, symmetric), Goblin Warchief (your Goblin spells cost 1 less;
Goblins have Haste). Verified in-node: Ghalta 12->2->0 as power grows,
Thalia +1 to both players' noncreature spells only, Warchief -1 to your
Goblins only + fresh Goblins attack immediately.

Skipped: Baral (second counter-draw ability), Storm-Kiln Artist (attack
scales per artifact + Magecraft), Gate Colossus (Affinity for Gates — no
Gates exist here), Gargos (vigilance/evasion + fight trigger).

entries.title: fight mechanic (two-target) + Prey Upon
entries.body:
Adds a `fight` effect and the engine's first two-target flow: a card with
fight:true asks you to pick your creature, then the creature it fights;
each deals damage equal to its power to the other (via damageCreature, so
deathtouch/shield/lifesteal all apply). The two picks fuse into one target
object ({uid: fighter, fightTarget: foe}) so nothing else needs a new
param. Client: commitPending runs the two-step pick and fight cards always
take the targeting path (never a direct drop). Added fight to the CHOSEN
targeting map (first pick = friendly-creature).

Card: Prey Upon. Verified in-node: survivor at correct HP, mutual lethal
kills, deathtouch fighter kills a bigger creature while dying to it,
targetSpec picks a friendly creature first.

Skipped: Primal Might (X-spell + optional fight on the same creature needs
X-scaled buff + optional second target) and Gargos (vigilance/evasion +
cost reduction). Two-step targeting UI needs a live realm test.

entries.title: delayed blink (return at next end step) + faithful Charming Prince
entries.body:
Adds `blink` with `delayed: true`: the creature is exiled immediately (gone
for the turn, so it dodges board wipes) and returns as a fresh permanent at
the beginning of the next end step, retriggering its Battlecry. Shared
returnBlinked() helper (immediate + delayed both reset the creature, keep
the blinkDepth loop guard, mark it summoning-sick). endTurn drains a new
state.pendingReturns list. Reuses the standard battlecry targeting, so no
client changes.

Charming Prince's blink mode is now delayed (matching MTG's "return at the
beginning of the next end step"); Felidar Guardian stays immediate. Both
timings now exist. Verified in-node: exile-now/return-EOT, damage reset,
battlecry retrigger, and dodging a Wrath cast while blinked.

entries.title: blink (flicker) effect + Felidar Guardian, Charming Prince
entries.body:
Blink is an effect-word (like bounce), not a creature passive: a battlecry
can "Blink target creature". It exiles the creature and immediately returns
it as a FRESH permanent — resetting damage/auras/temp-buffs and
retriggering its Battlecry. Tokens cease to exist when blinked (no return);
equipment detaches; excludeSelf keeps "another target creature" off the
source; a blinkDepth cap guards against infinite blink chains (Felidar +
Felidar). Added to the targeting CHOSEN map, so it reuses the standard
battlecry / choose-one targeting flows (no client changes). "Blink" is now
a glossary keyword term (keywords.js) for card-text bolding.

Cards: Felidar Guardian (Battlecry: blink another creature you control),
Charming Prince (Battlecry choose one: Scry 2 / gain 3 / blink another
creature you control). Verified in-node: damage reset, battlecry retrigger,
fresh uid, no self-blink loop, all Charming Prince modes.

Note: implemented as IMMEDIATE blink (return now), matching the requested
"retrigger its battlecry" behavior. MTG Charming Prince/Flickerwisp use a
delayed (end-of-turn) return; that timing would need a delayed-trigger
mechanic and is deferred.

entries.title: modal choose-two / one-or-more + Austere Command, Farewell
entries.body:
Extends the existing Choose-One system to multi-modal: `chooseCount` N
(choose exactly two) or `chooseMin`/`chooseMax` (choose one or more). The
`choice` param now accepts an array of mode indices; effectsOf concatenates
the chosen modes' effects (flows through runSpell/liveEffectsOf, so the
guest relay + host intent carry the array unchanged). Client adds a
toggle-and-confirm multi-select menu (main play + inspect panel).

Engine effects added: destroy-all now supports exile + minCost/maxCost (MV
filters); new clear-graveyards effect (Farewell's exile-all-graveyards).

Cards: Austere Command (choose two: destroy all artifacts / enchantments /
creatures MV<=3 / MV>=4), Farewell (choose one or more: exile all
artifacts / creatures / enchantments / graveyards). Verified in-node:
MV-filtered wipes, exile-not-graveyard, graveyard clear, arbitrary subsets.

Skipped: Cryptic Command (choose-two with two targets — engine is single-
target) and choose-one cards whose modes need unbuilt mechanics (flicker:
Charming Prince; tap/untap: Deceiver Exarch; proliferate: Cankerbloom;
evasion grants: Akroma's Will / Elder Gargaroth). Multi-select menu needs
a live realm test.

entries.title: kicker mechanic + Burst Lightning/Rite/Baloth/Bushwhacker
entries.body:
Adds a `kicker: { cost, effects }` field: an optional ADDITIONAL cost paid
on top of the base cost for a bonus. When kicked, playCard spends base +
kicker cost and sets card._kicked; liveEffectsOf appends the kicker effects
to the base ones (covers both runSpell and runBattlecry, so kicked spells
AND kicked creature ETBs work). runBattlecry now also fires for a kicked
creature with no base effects. Exports canKick.

Client: kicker cards you can afford base+kicker open a "Cast vs Cast with
kicker" menu (main play + drag paths); in the respond window a kicker
instant shows both options. A `kicked` flag threads through actPlay, the
pending play/respond commit, guest relay, and host intent (parallel to the
alt-cost useAlt flag).

Cards: Burst Lightning (2 dmg -> 4), Rite of Replication (1 copy -> 5),
Baloth Gorger (4/4 -> enters 7/7), Goblin Bushwhacker (kicked: your
creatures +1/+0 & gain Rush this turn). Verified in-node.

Skipped: Gatekeeper of Malakir (choice-edict unsupported), Into the Roil
(needs nonland-permanent bounce), Prohibit (counter-param kicker + MV<=N),
Vines of Vastwood (temp untargetable doesn't map). Cost menus need a live
realm test.

entries.title: alternative casting costs + Fireblast/FoW/FoN/Invigorate
entries.body:
Adds an `altCost` field: an optional cost paid INSTEAD of mana, chosen at
cast time. Supports require{land|notYourTurn}, life, sacrificeLand{color,
count}, exileFromHand{color,count}, opponentGain. Lands are basic-typed so
"sacrifice two Mountains" / "control a Forest" resolve faithfully. canPlay/
canCastInResponse allow a card affordable EITHER way; playCard takes a
useAlt flag (and auto-alts when mana is short, so the AI/any caller stays
safe). Also adds counter to:'exile' for Force of Negation.

Client: alt-cost cards you can pay both ways open a cost-choice menu (main
play + drag paths); in the respond window an alt counter shows as two
options (mana vs alt). useAlt threads through actPlay, the pending
play/respond commit, guest relay, and host intent.

Cards: Fireblast (sac 2 Mountains), Force of Will (1 life + exile a blue
card), Force of Negation (exile a blue card if not your turn; counters a
noncreature spell, exiling it), Invigorate (opponent gains 3 if you
control a Forest; +4/+4). Verified in-node: both cost paths, land-type
gating, life/exile payment, opponent-gain, and exile-on-counter.

Skipped as unmappable: Phyrexian mana (no colored pips) and Daze (returns
a land to hand, but this engine can't replay lands from hand). Cost-choice
menus need a live realm test, like the recent prompts.

entries.title: additional casting costs (discard/sacrifice) + 5 cards
entries.body:
Adds an `addCost` field for mandatory extra costs paid before a spell
resolves: { discard: N } reuses the existing discard picker; { sacrifice:
'creature'|'land'|'artifact'|'artifact-or-creature' } auto-sacs a fungible
land, auto-pays a lone option, or opens a new interactive sacrifice picker
(sacQueue) when there's a real choice. canPlay gates on affordability, and
the spell's effects resolve as the continuation once the cost is paid
(cost-before-effect, faithful). New sacQueue is fully client-wired
(picker modal, AI drain, guest relay, host intent, MP snapshot, gate).

Also fixed a latent gap: the guest-side modal dispatcher didn't handle
askQueue, so soft-counter / Rhystic / Smothering pay prompts wouldn't have
reached a GUEST controller. Added askQueue (and sacQueue) there.

Cards: Thrill of Possibility, Unexpected Windfall, Shard Volley, Reckless
Abandon, Deadly Dispute. Verified in-node: affordability gating, discard
draw, land auto-sac + burn, interactive creature sac holding damage until
chosen, single-option auto-sac, artifact-or-creature choice.

Note: additional-cost spells resolve off-stack (not counterable) so the
cost/effect order stays correct; and the new sac picker UI needs a live
realm test, same caveat as the recent prompts.

entries.title: attack-tax mechanic + Ghostly Prison
entries.body:
Adds an `attackTax` permanent field (Ghostly Prison: {amount:2}). A creature
may only be declared at a defender's hero if its controller can afford the
defender's summed attack tax; the cost is spent as an additional cost of
declaring (MTG's "pay as you declare attackers, or the declaration is
illegal"). Only creature attacks at the hero are taxed — creatures/walkers
and weapon-hero swings are untouched. Flows through client + AI unchanged
since both route via attackTargets()/attack().

Verified in-node: hero offered & charged 2 when affordable, gated out and
declaration rejected when not, creatures still free at 0 mana, no effect
when no Prison is in play.

entries.title: opponent-may-pay mechanic + Rhystic Study, Smothering Tithe
entries.body:
Generalizes the pay-prompt infra into an `opponent-may-pay` ongoing effect:
the opponent tied to a trigger (the spell's caster / the drawer) may pay N
via askQueue; if they don't (or can't afford it), the enchantment's
controller gets a benefit. Reuses the counter pay UI (askQueue is already
MP-synced + client-wired). Adds a new `enemy-draws` ongoing trigger fired
per opponent draw (guarded by state.dealt + a re-entrancy lock).

Cards: Rhystic Study (opponent pays 1 per spell or you draw), Smothering
Tithe (opponent pays 2 per draw or you make a Treasure). Verified in-node:
prompt routing to the right opponent, pay vs decline, can't-afford
auto-benefit, and per-card firing on multi-draws.

Note: vs the AI the pay prompt auto-resolves to "pay" (existing askQueue
behavior), so these read as PvP-facing taxes. The pay MODAL itself needs a
live realm test, same caveat as the counters/equip UI.

entries.title: conditional counters mechanic + 8 blue counterspells
entries.body:
Engine: counters gain an optional `counter` config — type/notType/manaValue
targeting restrictions (canCast gates on a legal matching stack spell), a
faithful interactive `unlessPay` soft counter (the countered spell's
controller gets a yes/no pay prompt via askQueue; the stack pauses until
answered), and a `to: hand|top` destination for counter-to-hand /
counter-to-top. Client: askQueue is now carried in MP snapshots and gates
human actions so a guest controller sees their pay prompt.

Cards: Negate, Dispel, Spell Snare, Mana Leak, Force Spike, Spell Pierce,
Remand, Memory Lapse. Full matrix verified in-node (target legality, pay
vs decline, hard-counter-when-broke, hand/top destinations).

The soft-counter pay MODAL + guest relay can only be exercised live, so it
still needs a realm test (same caveat as the equip UI).

entries.title: Battlecards WUBRG wave 12: 3 fully-faithful imports
entries.body:
Lotus Cobra (Landfall: gain 1 mana when a land enters), Revoke Existence
(exile an artifact/enchantment), Bronze Walrus (ETB scry 2). All verified
in-node against existing mechanics. Clone was evaluated but dropped: its
0/0 enter-as-copy needs a replacement-effect the engine can't model
faithfully.

entries.title: Battlecards WUBRG wave 11: 7 fully-faithful imports
entries.body:
Savannah Lions (vanilla 2/1), Counterspell (counter target spell),
Lightning Bolt (3 dmg any target), Chrome Cat (ETB scry 1),
Reclamation Sage / Nature's Claim / Slice in Twain (artifact/enchantment
removal). All map to existing engine mechanics with no compromises;
verified in-node.

entries.title: add Puresteel Paladin + Kor Outfitter (equipment-matters)
entries.body:
Puresteel Paladin: Metalcraft grants free equip at 3+ artifacts, and draws
a card whenever an Equipment enters. Kor Outfitter: battlecry attaches an
Equipment you control to a friendly creature.

entries.title: Equipment-matters: Stoneforge Mystic + Steelshaper's Gift
entries.body:
- search effect gains an `equipment:true` filter (tutor an Equipment from deck).
- deploy-equip effect + resolvePick mode: put an Equipment from hand into play
  (unattached); picks when you hold more than one.
- Steelshaper's Gift (W): tutor an Equipment to hand.
- Stoneforge Mystic (W, 1/2): Battlecry tutor an Equipment to hand, plus an
  activated (1): put an Equipment from your hand into play — once per turn
  (via abilityUsedThisTurn, matching the tap).

Verified in-engine: both tutor an Equipment (pick from deck); Stoneforge deploys
from hand to the artifacts zone and is correctly limited to once per turn.

entries.title: Equipment mechanic + 6 Equipment cards
entries.body:
Faithful creature Equipment (per the design decision):
- Equipment is an artifact with an `equip:{cost,attack?,health?,keywords?}` field.
  It plays to the artifacts zone unattached.
- New engine API: equipTargets / canEquip / equip(equipUid, creatureUid) — pay
  the equip cost, attach to one of your creatures. Bonuses apply via
  recomputeAuras, so they vanish if detached/destroyed.
- Persists: when the equipped creature dies it detaches and stays in play;
  re-equipping moves it. Destroying the Equipment removes the buff.
- Duel client: click an Equipment -> target one of your creatures (new 'equip'
  pending mode, guest-relay intent, equipAttached event log).

Cards (neutral artifacts, deck-legal): Bone Saw (+1/+0), Bonesplitter (+2/+0),
Short Sword (+1/+1), Vulshok Morningstar (+1/+1), Basilisk Collar (Deathtouch +
Lifesteal), Loxodon Warhammer (+3/+0, Trample, Lifesteal).

Verified in-engine: equip +2/+0; creature dies -> equipment persists & detaches;
re-equip moves it; destroy -> buff gone; two equipment stack; keyword-granting
works. Card game boots clean with the equip API. Live duel equip UI needs a
realm test.

entries.title: WUBRG import wave 10: 5 faithful cards (no evasion)
entries.body:
Per the decision to skip evasion keywords and keep adaptations faithful:
- Death Baron (B): aura — your other Undead get +1/+1 and Deathtouch (verified:
  buffs Undead only, not Beasts).
- Returned Reveler (B): Deathrattle — each player mills 3.
- Gifted Aetherborn (B): 2/3 Deathtouch + Lifesteal, Vampire.
- Shatter, Smelt (R): destroy an enemy artifact — added an only:'artifact'
  filter to destroy-art-ench so it spares enchantments (faithful).

The vanilla/keyword-creature pool with no evasion is exhausted; what remains
mostly needs evasion (skipped) or per-card design calls.

entries.title: WUBRG import wave 9: 11 cards
entries.body:
- White: Blade Splicer (Battlecry summon a 3/3 Golem), Fragmentize (destroy an
  artifact/enchantment), Ajani's Welcome (enchantment: gain 1 when a creature

entries.title: Keywords: split Deathtouch / Venomous / Poisonous (+ Poisoned condition)
entries.body:
They were all the same instant-kill. Now distinct:
- Deathtouch: any damage it deals to a creature destroys it (persistent).
- Venomous: same, but one-shot — spent after the first kill (like Divine Shield),
  and removed from the creature.
- Poisonous: doesn't kill outright — it applies the Poisoned condition.
- Poisoned: at the end of its controller's turn the creature takes 2 damage;
  persists until cleansed or dead.

The old `poisoned` flag (which actually meant "marked for death") is renamed to
`doomed`; `poisoned` now means the real condition. Added KW.VENOMOUS, the
end-of-turn poison tick, split the keyword glossary into four entries, and
taught the AI that Venomous (not Poisonous) counts as a kill.

Verified in-engine: 1-attack deathtouch/venomous each kill a 10-HP wall;
venomous is consumed after; poisonous leaves the wall alive+poisoned; the poison
deals 2 at the end of the controller's turn.

- MP: challenge party, accept-challenge match config, and the duel boot all
  carry hostCommander/hostCompanion + guestCommander/guestCompanion; mp.mjs

Verified: engine uses chosen loadout (p0) and empty for a deck with none (p1);
deckbuilder equips Sheriff Goldie + Dusty the Coyote, count shows +2 = 42, save

entries.title: Decks: 40 deck slots, Mage Starter seed, delete + empty-state
entries.body:
Deck storage moves from one-per-class to a list of up to 40 named PvP deck
slots (user.decks: [{id,name,classId,cards}]).

Backend (mp.mjs):
- normalizeDecks() migrates the old per-class object to slots one-time; legacy
  10-card starter decks are dropped, and if that leaves none you get a 40-card
  Mage Starter. New accounts start with the Mage Starter too. So both test
  accounts get a ready mage deck and can skip building.
- save-deck creates/updates a slot by id (cap 40, "slots full" past that);
  delete-deck removes one. reset-deck removed. Mage Starter validated against
  the real pool (exactly 40, mage/neutral, within copy caps).

Client:
- Deck builder is now slot-based: MY DECKS list (up to 40), ＋ New Deck, per-deck
  name, Save (create/update), Delete This Deck. Class stays the first choice.
  Free-play stores slots in localStorage (migrating the old single deck).
- Overworld card battle reads the slot array; with no valid 40-card deck it
  shows "You have no decks :(" and blocks the battle (both challenger and
  accepter). Deck-select labels show the deck name.

Verified: slot lifecycle headless (build→save→new→edit→delete, 0 errors);
backend slot/migration/cap/delete logic unit-tested against pool-rarity.json;
overworld boots clean.

entries.title: Decks: 40-card class-based PvP constructed + class-first builder

build their own from their collection; DECK_SIZE=40 in collection.js and the
MP backend (mp.mjs) validates 40. Overworld card-battle deck selection
(openDeckSelect + cardParty) now requires a full 40-card deck.

Dungeon runs are fully separated: dungeonStarterDeck() always uses the stock
10-card Dungeon.STARTER_DECKS and never reads the account's PvP decks, so a
dungeon deck can't leak into PvP and vice-versa.

Deckbuilder polish — class is the FIRST choice:
- No "all cards" option; you pick a class before anything shows.
- With no class the collection is a prompt ("choose your class"); picking one
  filters to neutral + that class (+ duals) and loads any deck saved for it.
- Switching class prunes off-class cards from the working deck.
- Count reads "/ 40"; save/auto-fill require a class; MP save stores a 40-card
  PvP deck per class ("take it into card battles").

Verified headless: builder boots to a class prompt at 0/40, picking Mage
filters the grid, no errors; overworld still boots clean.

entries.title: Rules: MTG hand-size cleanup + tokens exile on death
entries.body:
Hand size (MAX_HAND 15): drawing/gaining a card past 15 no longer burns it.
The hand may exceed 15 during your turn; at end of turn you discard down to 15,
MTG-style — YOUR choice which cards (human via the discard modal, AI dumps its
priciest). Replaces the old auto-pop-newest trim. Removed the burn-on-overdraw
in drawCards/addCardToHand/addCoin and the silent < MAX_HAND drops on
return-to-hand / copy-spell / conjure effects.

Tokens: instantiate() now carries the token flag, and every summoned token
(inline opt-summons included) is marked token:true. toGraveyard exiles any
token — summoned creatures, Blood/Clue/Food/Treasure — instead of sending it to
the graveyard, so tokens leave no corpse and can't be reanimated, referenced,
or reshuffled. Coins are NOT tokens and still go to the graveyard (reshuffle).

Verified in-engine: overdraw to 29 with no burn; end-of-turn queues a 14-card
choose-your-discard down to 15; deck-out reshuffles the graveyard (tokens
excluded); a summoned token dies to exile, not the graveyard.

entries.title: Coin & Banana are non-collectible but not tokens (reshuffle)
entries.body:
They were flagged token:true, which both hid them AND made them cease to
exist on deck reshuffle. Split those concerns:
- Coin & Banana: drop token, add collectible:false.
- All pool/collection/discover/generation filters now also exclude
  collectible:false (so they stay out of decks, the collectible pool, random
  generation, and are hidden in the gallery — unchanged behavior).
- The graveyard-reshuffle filter keys on token only, so Coin & Banana now
  reshuffle back into the deck; true tokens (Blood/Clue/Food/Treasure) still
  cease to exist. viewer isUncollectible + cardart honor collectible:false.

Verified: Coin/Banana reshuffle; Blood Token does not; they stay in Generic
and never appear under a collectible class.

entries.title: Treasure Token -> Token tribe; Coin & Banana -> Generic
entries.body:
- Treasure Token gets tribe "Token" (so it joins Generic and exiles instead
  of graveyarding, like Blood/Clue/Food).
- The Coin and Banana bucket into uncollectible Generic by id (kept as plain
  neutral token spells — no tribe/exile change). Generic is now 21.

entries.title: Token tribe -> Generic + exile-instead-of-graveyard
entries.body:
- Tag Blood Token, Clue Token, Food Token with tribe "Token".
- systemBucket buckets any Token-tribe card into uncollectible Generic
  (gallery + viewer), so those three move out of their class into Generic.
- toGraveyard now exiles Token-tribe cards instead of adding them to the
  graveyard (no corpse, unreanimatable). Verified in a live game: a Token
  creature dying lands in exile; a normal creature still goes to graveyard.

entries.title: optional draws — `may` prompt + draw-success gating
entries.body:
Add a reusable optional-decision mechanism so "you may …" effects actually
prompt and can be declined, and gate follow-ups on a real draw:
- drawCards() now returns the number of cards that reached hand.
- new effect `draw-then`: draw N, run `then` only if a card was drawn.
- new effect `may` + state.askQueue + resolveAsk(): defers a yes/no to the
  controller; AI auto-takes it (resolveAIAsks), the human gets a centered
  Draw/Pass popup (openAskModal, reusing the choose-one decision menu), with
  multiplayer guest relay (k:'ask').
- Arcane Artisan now uses may -> draw-then -> damage, so you may draw, and
  each opponent loses 1 Life only if you actually drew.

Verified in a live game: casting an Arcane spell (with an artifact) prompts;
Draw -> deck -1 and opponent -1; Pass -> no change; nothing happens until the
choice is made.

entries.title: add Arcane Artisan (sorcerer rare) + conditional trigger support
entries.body:
3-mana 3/3 Human Wizard: if you control an artifact or enchantment, whenever
you cast an Arcane spell, draw a card and each opponent loses 1 Life.

Wired as a spell-played ongoing gated by two new ongoingCondOk checks:
- cond.school: the played spell's school (schoolOf) must match (Arcane)
- cond.controlArtEnch: caster must control an artifact or enchantment
Both are additive and unused elsewhere, so no regression. Verified in a live
game: fires only with an artifact + Arcane spell (draw + opponent -1 Life),
gated off otherwise. Art cropped from the supplied card image.

entries.title: Battlecards/wiki: new Excavate uncollectible section (keeps rarity)
entries.body:
- Mark the 21 Azerite class legendaries with excavate:true.
- Add an "Excavate" bucket to the gallery/viewer uncollectible group, keyed
  off the excavate flag (checked first in systemBucket so these come out of
  their class sections).
- Unlike other uncollectible cards, excavate cards keep their rarity: add
  showsRarity(card) (collectible OR excavate) and use it for the rarity gem
